divisions.name: Human Resource Management Division
divisions.description: Employee lifecycle, digital service history, transfer and posting, promotion, seniority, APAR status, study leave, deputation, and retirement administration.

divisions.name: Human Resource Development Division
divisions.description: Cadre planning, sanctioned strength, welfare, holidays, training policy coordination with PDUNASS, and establishment policy.

divisions.name: Recruitment and Examination Division
divisions.description: Direct recruitment cycles, departmental exams, LDCEs, probation exams, vacancy compilation, and appointment tracking.

divisions.name: Administrative Services Division
divisions.description: Head Office administrative services, office inventory, stores, furniture, vehicles, telecom, ID cards, and procurement requests.

divisions.name: Physical Infrastructure Division
divisions.description: Estate and facility management, buildings, civil/electrical/HVAC works, preventive maintenance schedules, and AMC execution.

divisions.name: Finance and Accounts Division
divisions.description: Budget RE/BE compilation, financial sanctions, expenditure reconciliation, vendor payments, and financial MIS.

divisions.name: Compliance Division
divisions.description: Employer compliance oversight, risk-based inspection selection, 7A/14B proceedings policy, and default monitoring.

divisions.name: Recovery Division
divisions.description: Recovery case tracking, demand registers, attachment orders, bank/insolvency follow-up, and recovery performance.

divisions.name: Legal Division
divisions.description: Litigation management, court hearing calendar, advocate empanelment, judgment compliance, and legal precedent repository.

divisions.name: Information Services Division / NDC
divisions.description: Application portfolio register, ITSM, infrastructure inventory, VAPT/security remediation, and technology vendor governance.

divisions.name: Audit Division
divisions.description: Internal audit planning, audit engagements, observation/para management, auditee replies, and Action Taken Report (ATR) settlement.

divisions.name: Vigilance Division
divisions.description: Vigilance complaint tracking, confidential inquiry workflow, sensitive post monitoring, and preventive vigilance governance.

divisions.name: Investment Division
divisions.description: Portfolio monitoring, investment manager mandates, benchmark compliance, exposure limits, and committee reporting.

divisions.name: Pension Division
divisions.description: Pension policy, higher-pension implementation monitoring, operational exception aggregation, and disbursement assurance.

divisions.name: International Cooperation for Social Security
divisions.description: Social Security Agreements (SSA), Certificate of Coverage (COC) issuance workflow, and detached worker case tracking.

divisions.name: Exemption Division
divisions.description: Exempted establishment trust monitoring, compliance return validation, condition reviews, and surrender/cancellation workflows.

divisions.name: Customer Service Division
divisions.description: Grievance escalation oversight (EPFiGMS/CPGRAMS), PRO desk guidance, root-cause analytics, and service quality improvement.

divisions.name: Communication and Public Relations Division
divisions.description: Public communication, press releases, social media campaigns, media query responses, and creative approval workflows.

divisions.name: Coordination / MIS / Parliamentary Questions
divisions.description: CPFC/CBT decision tracking, Parliamentary Question coordination, Ministry references, and Annual Report compilation.

divisions.name: Official Language Division
divisions.description: Rajbhasha compliance, translation queue, bilingual terminology repository, Section 3(3) monitoring, and quarterly progress returns.
